research_scope: Fifteen base-game skills from PQ86-PQ100. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

duplicate_check.repository_search_note: All fifteen selected names were checked against the live repository before insertion. Charge and Flash Bomber were excluded because they already have canonical research batches.

verification_audit.research_update: Current-evidence promotion completed for Neo Wolf Fang Fist. Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation confirms the variable 100–700 Ki Strike Super and 9–33 hit continuable rush; independent PQ reward documentation corroborates PQ86 as the acquisition endpoint. Historical community reports about older resource behavior are retained as provenance and are not used to override current documentation. Exact reward probability and hidden Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Neo Wolf Fang Fist
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 86 — Yamcha is Number One
records.skill_description: An enhanced Wolf Fang Fist sequence that can be extended while the input is held.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Neo Wolf Fang Fist as a Strike Super with a variable 100–700 Ki cost and 9–33 hit continuable rush. The user spin-kicks into a clawing barrage, can continue the sequence while the input is held, and ends by knocking the opponent away. Current documentation records up to 40% damage for the full sequence. Independent current/archived reporting confirms PQ86 — Yamcha is Number One as the acquisition endpoint; exact reward probability and any hidden gate remain unresolved.

records.name: Atomic Blast
records.character_source: Prince of Destruction Vegeta; SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved)
records.skill_description: Fires a chargeable Ki wave; timing the release before full charge can produce the stronger documented behavior.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Atomic Blast as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super unlocked through PQ87. It is chargeable: no-charge, partial-charge, and full-charge releases have distinct documented behavior, with stronger timing/grounded-release cases; SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved) has a faster/close-range charging variant. Universal damage percentages are not promoted as canonical.

records.name: Buu Buu Ball
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 88 — Evil Seeks Dragon Balls Yet Again!
records.skill_description: Rolls into a ball and bounces while the user can freely control movement.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Buu Buu Ball as a Strike Evasive using 300 Stamina, restricted to Majin CaCs, with three controllable bounces and minor contact damage. The current PQ88 reward transcription places Buu Buu Ball in the Basic Reward list. Historical player discussion reports an Ultimate-Finish belief, so ultimate_finish_required remains null and no drop probability is inferred.

records.name: Victory Rush
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 89 — Super-Super Ultimate Series of Battles!
records.skill_description: Teleports into the opponent and performs a multi-hit rush ending in an axe kick.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence supports Victory Rush as a 300-Ki Strike Ultimate from PQ89, using a documented 13-hit teleporting rush ending in an axe kick. Exact universal damage and drop probability remain unresolved.

records.name: III Bomber
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 90 — Gathering of the Great Evil Alliance
records.skill_description: Creates an unblockable explosion and hides the user from opponent lock-on.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation identifies III Bomber (also documented as Ill Bomber/Revenge Death Bomber) as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki and restricted to Majin CaCs. The attack creates an unblockable explosion and hides the user from opponent lock-on for about 5 seconds while allowing movement during invisibility.

records.name: Final Kamehameha
records.character_source: Vegito; SSGSS Vegito; SSGSS Vegito customizable partner
records.skill_description: Charges a Final Flash and transitions into a Super Kamehameha beam.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Final Kamehameha as a 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user charges a Final Flash, transitions into a Super Kamehameha, and fires a long-range 22-hit beam. Current acquisition documentation lists PQ91, the TP Medal Shop, and Double Crystal Raids. PQ91 reward transcription independently places Final Kamehameha in Basic Reward; archived player discussion reports Ultimate-Finish farming, so ultimate_finish_required remains null and no probability is inferred.

records.name: Maiden Burst
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 92 — Revenge of the Tuffle
records.skill_description: Creates a defensive Ki explosion while evading an opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill references classify Maiden Burst as a Ki Blast Evasive using 300 stamina; PQ92 reward is independently confirmed.

records.name: Bluff Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 94 — Ultimate Power, Ultimate Saiyan
records.skill_description: Performs a fake Kamehameha that can manipulate the opponent rather than functioning as a conventional damaging beam.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill references classify Bluff Kamehameha as an Other Super using 100 Ki; it is a deceptive Kamehameha-style utility skill rather than a conventional damaging beam.

records.name: Drain Field
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 95 — Super 17, the Ultimate Android
records.skill_description: Creates an energy-draining field while evading attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: Current evidence identifies Drain Field as Super 17's Other-type Super. PQ95's maintained reward transcription lists Drain Field alongside Flash Bomber as a Basic Reward. Community testing consistently reports that the move absorbs incoming Ki-based attacks and returns Ki to the user; accessible testing reports zero Ki cost. Exact game-data resource value and drop probability are not independently established here.

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.character_source: Eis Shenron; Omega Shenron Customize Partner
records.skill_description: Uses a defensive evasive technique that creates a freezing effect around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Absolute Zero as a Ki Blast Evasive using 300 Stamina; the user takes a counter stance and attackers are frozen for about 3 seconds.

records.name: Charged Ki Wave
records.character_source: Multiple fighters including Future Warrior; Nuova Shenron
records.skill_description: Charges and releases a controllable Ki wave.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific evidence classifies Charged Ki Wave as an Other Super using 100 Ki. It restores Stamina by consuming Ki and completes faster than Rise to Action. PQ97 is the Future Warrior acquisition route.

records.name: Phantom Fist
records.skill_description: A deceptive close-range strike that uses phantom-like movement to reach the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific evidence classifies Phantom Fist as an Other Super using 100 Ki. It functions as an afterimage-style evasive state; successfully evading an attack restores roughly 100 Stamina. PQ97 is the Future Warrior acquisition route.

records.name: Dimension Ray
records.skill_description: Fires a dimensional energy beam through a spatial rift.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Dimension Ray as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 400 Ki and describes a 19-hit long-range barrage.

records.name: Emperor's Edge
records.skill_description: Fires a precise Frieza-style energy attack at the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Future Warrior technique references identify Emperor's Edge as Golden Frieza's Super Skill and place it among Frieza-style Death Wave variants. PQ99 is the base-game acquisition endpoint in the maintained reward transcription. The current evidence reviewed here does not independently establish a different attack-type label beyond its Frieza energy-attack family, so no speculative subtype is promoted.

records.name: X100 Big Bang Kamehameha
records.skill_description: Fires an enormous combined Big Bang Attack and Kamehameha energy wave.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Future Warrior technique references identify x100 Big Bang Kamehameha as Gogeta's Ultimate Skill. PQ100 is the maintained base-game acquisition endpoint; the TP Medal Shop is also an acquisition route in current technique documentation.

audit_note: 2026-09-24 P1 enrichment follow-up: refreshed Charged Ki Wave, Phantom Fist, Bluff Kamehameha, Emperor's Edge, and X100 Big Bang Kamehameha from current skill/technique references and the maintained PQ reward transcription. Resource costs and core classifications were promoted only where directly supported; exact reward probabilities remain unresolved.
